about.name: Bashar Mestrih
about.title: Frontend Developer
about.description: I am Mobile app/Frontend developer focused on building intuitive, high-performance mobile and web applications with clean UI and scalable architecture. Collaborate with customers to ideate app concepts leveraging Flutter’s widgets and React’s components for rapid prototyping.

description: Develop and maintain global websites and web applications with React.js and Next.js.
Build interactive event experiences with responsive, reusable UI components and API integrations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-quality frontend solutions.
Built Flutter interfaces with GetX, BLOC, and Provider state management.
Integrated Google Maps, Stripe, File Picker, OneSignal, Firebase, and Supabase.
Connected Laravel APIs with MongoDB and PostgreSQL, and supported deployment and marketing.
Support frontend development for a platform connecting Syrian talent with the European market.
Contribute design ideas that improve the platform's usability and visual direction.
Help create and refine the web app's UI/UX for a better user experience.
Teach Python fundamentals through clear, accessible coding lessons.
Lead hands-on Arduino activities with circuits, sensors, and electronic projects.
Guide learners in building practical projects such as smart gadgets and mini-robots.
